notes.title: New Level! The Hatchery
notes.notes:
[b]Also contains 2 new Dinosaur enemies! The Allosaurus and the Allosaurus Mother[/b]
[h1]This new level takes you to one of the secret breeding facilities on the Island. [/h1]

Inspired by community feedback, this update contains:

[b][list]
[*] A new level added to the main story
[*] The Allosaurus New Dinosaur Enemy
[*] Egg nests to destroy
[*] New hidden tapes with audio logs
[*] Dinosaur Museum
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Update 0.2 Is Here
notes.notes:
Another update is here! This one adds some things I thought would make the gameplay more fun like more guns and ammo drops.
[h2][list]
[*]Added Sniper / Shotgun to Level 3
[*]More ammo drops on Levels 2 and 5
[*]Dinosaur Ai adjusted very slightly
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: Thank You
notes.notes:
First two weeks after launch is now here, It has been awesome and I've really enjoyed seeing everyone enjoying the game!

The amount of positive reviews and feedback I've received so far is absolutely overwhelming.

I'm are really grateful to all contributors, content creators, journalists, reviewers and everyone who bought the game.

I will continue development of Dino Genesis and post updates.

Thank you everyone for your support.

notes.title: Update .1 Is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]This update fixes bugs and glitches pointed out by the community. 
[/b][/h1]
[h2][list]
[*]Fixed player getting stuck in a wall on 1st level
[*]Adjusted Triceratops walking speed and Collision box staying behind when dead
[*]Added Assault Rifle to Level 2 (Radio Room)
[*]More Ammo Drops on Last Level
[/list][/h2]

notes.title: Release Date & Price
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm very excited to announce the release date and price of Dino Genesis! The game will be released to early access on the 24th of March and will be priced at $6.99 USD with a 35% off for the first 7 days of early access!

Its been awesome developing Dino Genesis and Im so excited for people to play it!

All the best,
Braden
